title: IBM Quantum Development Roadmap
description: IBM's vision to deliver 100,000+ qubit systems by 2033 through modular quantum processors, error correction breakthroughs, and the Qiskit software stack evolution.

title: Google Quantum AI Roadmap
description: Google's roadmap toward building a useful, error-corrected quantum computer. Milestones include quantum supremacy (Sycamore 2019), below-threshold error correction (Willow 2024), and a long-lived logical qubit.

title: Microsoft Azure Quantum & Topological Qubits
description: Microsoft's approach using topological qubits (Majorana zero modes) for inherently fault-tolerant quantum computing, integrated with Azure Quantum cloud services.

title: IonQ — Trapped Ion Quantum Computing Roadmap
description: IonQ's roadmap toward commercial-grade trapped-ion quantum computers with high connectivity, long coherence times, and the '#AQ' algorithmic qubit metric.

title: Quantinuum — H-Series Quantum Computers
description: Quantinuum's H-Series trapped-ion processors use QCCD architecture for all-to-all connectivity. Roadmap targets fault-tolerant quantum computing with industry-leading gate fidelities.

title: Rigetti — Superconducting Quantum Computing
description: Rigetti's roadmap for scalable superconducting quantum processors with multi-chip architectures, integrated with their Quilc compiler and Forest SDK.

title: PsiQuantum — Photonic Quantum Computing at Scale
description: PsiQuantum's silicon-photonic approach aims to build million-qubit fault-tolerant quantum computers using existing semiconductor manufacturing infrastructure.

title: AWS Center for Quantum Computing
description: AWS's quantum computing strategy providing cloud access to multiple hardware technologies (superconducting, trapped-ion, photonic) through Amazon Braket, plus in-house quantum hardware research.
